parameters.content:
## BookLeaf approve draft
POST /webhook/royalty-summary/approve with header X-BookLeaf-Key (n8n Header Auth). Every business answer is HTTP 200 with the same fields.
**Check Edit** re-runs the fact check on the edited subject/body; **Decide** works out every answer: **check** returns a preview at once; **discard** closes the draft; **send** claims it atomically for this execution (one email per draft, however many clicks), answers at once, then hands the email to the **Deliver Email** sub-workflow. Code nodes are generated from n8n/src by n8n/build.mjs.

## Intake
The settings (bad: 500), then the body (bad: 400). Database down before the answer: 503.

## Load & decide
Re-checks the edit and works out every answer.

## Send
One click wins the draft; the email goes out once.

## Discard or check
Closes the draft, or answers a preview.

parameters.query: SELECT jsonb_object_agg(key, value) AS settings FROM bookleaf_settings

SELECT job_id::text AS job_id, status, stage, delivery, tone, length, sign_off, recipient, author_code,
  sections, facts, titles, drills, drafted_at, (drafted_at > now() - make_interval(hours => bookleaf_setting('draft_ttl_hours')::int)) AS fresh
FROM royalty_jobs WHERE job_id = ($1::jsonb->>'job_id')::uuid

nodes.name: Check Edit
nodes.notes: Same fact checker as the AI

parameters.query:
UPDATE royalty_jobs
SET status = 'DISCARDED', stage = 'discarded', stage_at = now(), completed_at = now(), updated_at = now()
WHERE job_id = ($1::jsonb->>'job_id')::uuid AND status = 'DRAFTED'
RETURNING job_id::text AS job_id, status

UPDATE royalty_jobs SET status = 'PROCESSING', stage = 'sending', execution_id = $1::jsonb->>'execution_id',
  stage_at = now(), updated_at = now()
WHERE job_id = ($1::jsonb->>'job_id')::uuid AND status = 'DRAFTED' AND drafted_at > now() - make_interval(hours => bookleaf_setting('draft_ttl_hours')::int)
RETURNING job_id::text AS job_id, status
